newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian shares edge higher, mkt seeks direction.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian shares edge higher, mkt seeks direction.

text.p: Hungarian share prices closed mixed with a slight positive tone on Friday as the last batch of first half earnings reports came out.
The BUX index finished at 7,799.02 points, up 57.27 points or 0.74 percent.
Traders said the market was seeking direction after this week's hectic moves.

"Some decisive questions have to be answered in the next few days before the market begins to move," said Gyorgy Czipo of ING Barings. "Question remains where the dollar fixes, what steps the Fed will take and how investors react to earnings."
The Budapest bourse's fortunes turned this week after an almost continuous increase this year in which the BUX index doubled in forint terms.
In the first four days of the week the BUX index slid more than seven percent as reaction to mixed batches of corporate earnings.

On Friday, several of those firms which released their figures, closed higher. OTP Bank ended at 6,660 forints, up 120; tile manufacturer Zalakeramia ended at 8,000 forints, up 150 and retailer Fotex at 236, up three.
Chemicals TVK, whose volume was boosted by a block deal for 760,000 units at 4,010 forint, finished at 4,205, up 55.
